source.content: @isTest private class EnterpriseDescribeFixtureTest { @isTest static void describesEnterpriseMetadata() { Map<String,Object> globalDescribe = Schema.getGlobalDescribe(); Object accountType = globalDescribe.get('Account'); Object accountDescribe = accountType.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('Account', accountDescribe.getName()); Object fieldsToken = accountDescribe.fields; Map<String,Object> fields = fieldsToken.getMap(); System.assert(fields.containsKey('Rating')); Object ratingDescribe = Account.Rating.getDescribe(); List<Object> values = ratingDescribe.getPicklistValues(); System.assertEquals(2, values.size()); Object hot = values.get(0); System.assertEquals('Hot Label', hot.getLabel()); Map<String,Object> byDeveloperName = accountDescribe.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName(); Object business = byDeveloperName.get('Business'); System.assertEquals('Business Account', business.getName()); List<Object> childRelationships = accountDescribe.getChildRelationships(); System.assertEquals(1, childRelationships.size()); Object contacts = childRelationships.get(0); System.assertEquals('Contacts', contacts.getRelationshipName()); } }
